topic.title: How to read a study abstract in 60 seconds

instagram.text:
Most claims fall apart in the methods section.

How to read a study abstract in 60 seconds — today's research education note from Lion Elite Wellness.

• Check the model: cells, animal models, or human trials.
• Check the sample size and whether there was a control.
• The conclusion sentence is written to be quoted — read past it.

Sourcing for a lab or research team? Reach out about wholesale inquiries.

For laboratory research purposes only. Not for human or veterinary use.
